ideas.pitch: A Python-based competitive programming utility that parses student submissions, runs dynamic test suites with isolated memory constraints, and generates logic-failure heatmaps.
ideas.title: LogicArena Python Benchmarker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting Python capability directly matches the hackathon's explicit focus on honing abilities in Python and logical reasoning.

ideas.pitch: An interactive logic puzzle platform built for Grades 9-12 students featuring step-by-step constraint satisfaction problem generators.
ideas.title: Algorist Logical Reasoning Trainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the target demographic of school students by gamifying the exact logical reasoning skills tested in the arena.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight visual execution tracer for Python code designed to help high schoolers step through complex loops and recursive functions.
ideas.title: CodeTrace Python Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly supports the permitted language stack (Python) and addresses common learning hurdles for beginner to intermediate coders.

ideas.pitch: A custom static analysis tool built in Python that evaluates student code submissions not just for correctness, but for algorithmic efficiency and style.
ideas.title: SyntaxScore Code Quality Linter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies deeper software engineering principles to introductory competitive programming, appealing to rigorous judges.

ideas.pitch: An educational Python toolkit for visualizing binary operations, truth tables, and Boolean algebra for high school computer science curricula.
ideas.title: Bitwise Logic Playground
ideas.why_it_could_win: Serves as an ideal teaching aid that fits comfortably within a short 24-48 hour solo development window.
